title: Mum sitting on the toilet spooked as 'child ghost' unfurls loo roll on video
excerpt: Amelia Worthington reckons she spoke to a 'child spirit' that unfurled the roll on command in her haunted house
content:
A mum claims a 'child spirit' unravelled the toilet roll in her bathroom as she sat on the loo - even stopping and starting on demand. Amelia Worthington had nipped upstairs to use the loo on and was shocked to find some of the toilet roll had already been unravelled.

The 26-year-old claims no one had been upstairs in her 1980s house for a few hours and when she last checked the toilet paper it was neatly rolled up.

But when the mum-of-two sat down to pee, she claims the paper began to move at speed and unrolled into a pile on the floor. In shock, Amelia began filming the action on her phone and started to speak to the 'spirit'.

Footage shows the toilet roll unwinding at speed into a pile on the floor as Amelia is sitting on the toilet In the video, Amelia asks the 'spirit' to stop and the paper is seen to slow down.

‌

She then asks it to stop a second time and in that moment the paper stops moving completely. When she watched the footage back on her phone, Amelia claims she spotted small fingerprints at the top of the paper.

And after posting her video on social media, other users also agreed they could make out finger indentations on the toilet roll.

Since moving into the property in January, Amelia claims to have heard footsteps and floorboards creaking upstairs without any explanation and says her two dogs often bark, growl and stare at random corners of the house.

‌

Amelia now believes the toilet roll chaos was caused by a 'child spirit' due to the size of the finger marks spotted in the paper and is speaking out about her 'haunted' experience.

Amelia, from Derby in Derbyshire, said: "I've gone to have a wee and the next moment it [the toilet roll] started moving.

"At this point I didn't feel uneasy so I started to speak to it [the spirit]. It was still unrolling quite fast."I'd asked it to stop once and it slowed down a little bit. I raised my voice and said 'stop' and it stopped completely."I was in shock because it stopped when I asked it too. That was clarification for me that something was there. "I had gone all cold and goosebumps and this is what happens when I feel something around me. "Apparently they [spirits] do like to play with toilet rolls to grab your attention and let you know that someone is there.

‌

"My other thing that people pointed out to me on my video is the finger indentations [in the toilet paper]."At the time, I didn't see this happening but I rewatched the video over and over, I could see little finger marks. "Looking back at this it makes me feel quite uneasy. At the time when it was happening it didn't. "With the indents of the fingers [on the toilet paper], they're quite small which is why I believe it to be a child spirit."

Amelia claims there could be up to two child spirits present in her semi-detached home. She claims they could be her unborn children watching over her after she sadly lost two babies through miscarriages.

Amelia also claims her three-year-old Jenson regularly wakes up in the middle of the night claiming to have spotted a three-year-old boy in his room.

‌

Alongside the child spirits, she also claims an adult spirit haunts their two-bedroom property after her partner Josh claims he spotted a tall figure in their kitchen.

Amelia said: "Last week, my partner was in the kitchen and he was looking in the mirror in there and he claims a tall figure had walked from one side of the kitchen wall to the other and then it disappeared.

"My little boy who's three, for about two months now, he'll wake up every single night and say someone is in his room.

‌

"He always says there's a little boy in his room. He says the same thing every single time.

"We didn't know the gender of one of the babies we lost but when I ask my little boy how old the little boy is that he sees in his room, he says he's three years old.

"This would make sense with what happened to me [losing my baby].

‌

"I definitely think there are both my children [that I've lost] in here and an adult spirit, who I've not worked out who that is yet.

"It's nice to know that someone is with me and watching over me."

Amelia says her 56-year-old mum Netti has since shown a paranormal investigator the footage and claims he agreed the moving toilet paper was proof of spirit activity.

Amelia then shared the video on social media and the post has since racked up more than 30,000 views and comments.

‌

Amelia said: "I haven't posted it for people to believe it or not, they can take what they want from it. I just posted it to share my experience.

"Someone said to me they didn't believe it until they saw my video."

After watching the video, some users were sceptical and said it was 'gravity' causing the paper to unravel, but other users said they could make out the finger indents in the loo roll too.

‌

One user said: "That's just momentum. Once it starts it keeps going."

Another added: "Wow you can see a finger indentation. That's mad, the best I've seen yet."

A third commented: "It's called gravity."

A fourth added: "OMG! The indentations when you say STOP and then start again. That's absolutely mental!"

‌
